VBO:0200195.summary: Friendly in her owner’s account, five-year-old Lizzy is a Borgi, a Border Collie–Welsh Corgi cross, who enjoys company and another dog’s companionship. Eight-year-old Corky offers an active individual account: he still makes time for snuggling, chews squeaky toys and sleeps near fireplaces. His owner also reports barking and chasing trucks. These are two dogs’ stories, rather than a fixed temperament for the cross.
